summary: @ornikar/prismic-components preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as `@ornikar/prismic-components` but ships no Prismic component code — only two files: `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js`. The `preinstall` script invokes `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, extracts it, chmods it executable, and immediately runs `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit'})`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with rotated string-array indirection and hex-mangled identifiers; no source form is shipped and the payload is opaque without executing it under Bun. Fetching a second runtime specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated payload during `npm install` runs arbitrary attacker-controlled code on every installer's machine and bypasses Node-based static analysis. The scoped name is consistent with impersonation of the Ornikar organization, whose actual Prismic component code is not present.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
